title: Performance metrics in machine learning: a scenario-based guide from the confusion matrix to calibration, regression and uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2611.08048v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Performance metrics can yield different conclusions from the same predictions. This methodological tutorial explains the effects of class prevalence, decision thresholds, aggregation rules and software conventions through controlled scenarios. Twenty-two confusion-matrix metrics are organized in a prevalence-coded map. Fifteen scenarios cover binary and multi-class classification, score discrimination, probability calibration, regression, uncertainty and consistency checks. Inputs are fixed in released files, and one factor is varied in each scenario. All 205 verification checks passed; 202 were independent and 3 were internal. An always-negative rule achieved an accuracy of 0.990 at a prevalence of 0.010, with balanced accuracy of 0.500. At fixed sensitivity and specificity, precision fell from 0.889 to 0.008 as prevalence fell from 0.5 to 0.001. Three probability variants shared a ROC-AUC of 0.825 but had calibration slopes of 2.08, 1.

translated_title: 机器学习中的性能指标：从混淆矩阵到校准、回归与不确定性的基于场景的指南
translated_abstract: 性能指标在相同的预测结果下可能得出不同的结论。本方法论教程通过受控场景解释了类别流行率、决策阈值、聚合规则和软件约定的影响。22种混淆矩阵指标被组织成一张按流行率编码的地图。15个场景涵盖二分类和多分类、评分判别力、概率校准、回归、不确定性及一致性检查。输入在发布的文件中固定，每个场景仅改变一个因素。所有205项验证检查均通过；其中202项为独立验证，3项为内部验证。一个“总是预测为负”的规则在流行率为0.010时达到0.990的准确率，但平衡准确率仅为0.500。在敏感度和特异度固定的情况下，当流行率从0.5降至0.001时，精确率从0.889降至0.008。三个概率变体共享0.825的ROC-AUC，但校准斜率却分别为2.08、1（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本教程通过15个受控场景系统揭示了类别流行率、决策阈值等因素如何使相同的预测在不同性能指标下得出截然不同的结论，为机器学习评估指标的正确选择与解读提供了实用指南。
en_tdlr: This tutorial systematically demonstrates through 15 controlled scenarios how class prevalence, decision thresholds, and aggregation rules can lead identical predictions to yield contradictory conclusions under different performance metrics, providing a practical guide for properly selecting and interpreting evaluation metrics in machine learning.
